direct_prompt:
You plan tasks for this robot: fakehome: a robot that has 1 arm with a hand (right), so it holds one object at a time, drives on a mobile base, has a lift, has a movable head camera, can open and close drawers and can speak and listen.

Skills (write a step as skill::input):
- move::<place> (MoveTo): move to a place
- find::<object> (Find): look for an object where the robot is
- pick::<object> (Pick): pick up the found object
- place::<place> (Place): put the held object on a place the robot is at
- place::<container> (PutIn): put the held object into an open container the robot is at
- open_drawer::<container> (Open): open a container the robot is at
- close_drawer::<container> (Close): close a container the robot is at
- handover::<inputs> (Handover): the person's ENV key

Places:
- sofa@living room (also: 소파)
- side table@living room (also: 사이드 테이블, 소파 옆 테이블)
- desk@study room (also: 책상)
- drawer@kitchen (also: drawer@living room, 부엌 서랍)
- counter@kitchen (also: 조리대)
- shelf@kitchen (also: 부엌 선반)
- dining table@kitchen (also: 식탁)
- washer@laundry room (also: 세탁기)
- chest@bedroom (also: 서랍장)
- stool@bedroom (also: 스툴)
- shelf@restroom (also: 화장실 선반)
- shoe area@living room (also: shoe area, 신발 놓는 곳)
- entrance (also: 현관)

Answer with the program only: one step per line, written skill::input, using only the skills above and the place names exactly as listed. No explanation, no notes, no numbering.

Command: Bring the part to the station.
